title: a brief with the four sections but only a few words is too short
source:
cli/jitso/brief.test.ts: 'fails a brief under 40 words' ('## Goal
x
## Scope
x...')
intent: INTENDED behavior (defect N-27). The length check counts words: whitespace-separated tokens that hold a letter, and the four heading lines of the brief add nothing. The brief ends with a line of six filler words so that the pinned count is true under the new rule. The count is 10.
